title: Say Hello on WhatsApp
text: Tap Book Us Now and tell us about your space. We will reply personally to arrange a time to talk.

title: Consultation
text: We visit your space, listen to how you live and talk through your style, needs and budget.

title: Concept & Mood Board
text: We present a design concept with mood boards, layouts and finishes for you to refine with us.

title: Design & Installation
text: We finalise the details, source every piece and manage the installation from start to finish.

title: The Reveal
text: We style the finished space down to the last cushion, then hand it over, ready to enjoy.
